#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

LOCAL="{{local_dir}}"
DST="{{s3_uri}}"

echo "=== dry-run ==="
aws s3 sync "$LOCAL" "$DST" \
  --exclude "*.DS_Store" --exclude ".git/*" --exclude "node_modules/*" \
  --dryrun

read -rp "proceed? (y/N) " ans
[[ "$ans" == "y" ]] || exit 0

aws s3 sync "$LOCAL" "$DST" \
  --exclude "*.DS_Store" --exclude ".git/*" --exclude "node_modules/*" \
  --delete
summary_zh: S3 sync 先 dry-run 再確認執行
